course_dna.identity_summary: A long tree-lined parkland layout that rewards elite approach play from 150-200 yards and penalizes positional mistakes off the tee.

primary_demands.label: Approach Play
primary_demands.reason: Narrow tree-lined corridors force precise iron play; 44% of approaches arrive from 150-200 yards.

primary_demands.label: Iron Play 150-200yd
primary_demands.reason: Mid-iron precision separates scoring at this length; proximity from 150-200 directly correlates with birdie conversion.

primary_demands.label: Driving Accuracy
primary_demands.reason: Tree-lined fairways penalize errant tee shots with blocked approaches and penalty stroke exposure.

primary_demands.label: Par-5 Scoring
primary_demands.reason: Three reachable par-5s provide concentrated birdie opportunity for players who can both reach and convert.

primary_demands.label: Putting
primary_demands.reason: Bentgrass greens at moderate speed reward consistent putting after birdie-range approaches.

scoring_opportunities: Three reachable par-5s where two-putt birdies are available for long hitters.
Mid-iron birdie setups when approach play is elite — proximity from 150-175 yards is the scoring engine.
Early wave scoring advantage on calm mornings before afternoon wind.
primary_failure_modes: Missed fairways into trees produce blocked approaches and bogey exposure.
Approach play below field average leads to long-birdie attempts and net pars.
Putting volatility erases approach-play gains — this course does not forgive wasted birdie chances.
course_dna.weather_context: Calm early-week forecast; afternoon wind 8-12mph possible by the weekend.

badges.label: Putter
badges.qualification_reason: putting at 86th percentile exceeds the 80th-percentile threshold.

form_evidence: 1 top-10 in last 8 starts; 2 missed cuts in last 6 events.
Strokes gained approach has been inconsistent — strong in one event, below-field the next.

evidence: 1 start at Detroit Golf Club; made cut, finished T31.

risk_factors.label: Driving accuracy deficit
risk_factors.description: Driving accuracy at 18th percentile — well below the threshold needed to avoid tree exposure at Detroit Golf Club. A penalty stroke in a tree-lined corridor costs a birdie.
